name: handoff
description: Writes a structured handover prompt (goals, modified files, dependencies, next steps) for a new session when context reaches 250k tokens, or on /handoff.

enabled.title: Enabled
enabled.description: Turn handoff on or off; off unloads its hooks until turned back on.

threshold_tokens.title: Context threshold (tokens)
threshold_tokens.description: Write a handover automatically once the context reaches this size.

auto.title: Automatic handover
auto.description: Write the handover by itself at the threshold; off leaves only /handoff.

folder.title: Handover folder
folder.description: Where handover files are written, relative to the working directory.
